name: Ioun Stone Southern Star
body:
Southern Star (Normal) Ioun Stone
Source Heroes from the Fringe pg. 15
Aura strong transmutation; CL 12th
Slot none; Price 8,000 gp; Weight —
Description
This brilliant, deep violet crystal is perfectly cut in the shape of a five-pointed star. The gem grants its bearer a swim speed of 30 feet. When inserted into a wayfinder, it allows the bearer to breathe water for up to 10 minutes per day (in 1-minute increments).
Resonance
Can breath water for 10 minutes a day
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, touch of the sea, creator must be at least 12th level; Cost 4,000 gp
